title: SJMV: push sjmvp (ded9f77) to SJMVparish/website main and verify

Check Vercel deployment is not blocked (author must be SJMVParish noreply), then confirm the live bundle uses ixfzajjtzuwelkjnssjt, no demo banner, OFW fields show. Training was the next day (2026-11-14).

title: SJMV: deploy the three Edge Functions to project ixfzajjtzuwelkjnssjt
description: Needs a Supabase access token of the account that owns SJMV's project. From PARISH-REGISTRY-sjmvp: npx supabase login --token <sbp_...>, npm run deploy:functions, then npx supabase logout. Or use npm run parish -- token sjmv and npm run release:functions -- sjmv from the main folder. Migrations 0102-0124 were already run by hand in the SQL editor and verified (all objects present).

title: olgqp: prepare parish/olgqp before any push
description: Worktree PARISH-REGISTRY-olgqp, branch parish/olgqp (from main ca5f892, identity guadalupe-muaan). Before pushing: git rm the tracked client/.env.local (points at the demo DB and beats .env.production), confirm LIVE_PROJECT_ID/.env.production/vercel.json are Guadalupe's, check commit author, then push with a named remote (olgqp remote = guadalupe-muaan/parish-registry). Verify the live bundle uses rmlkowkbonbrtaqocsvo.

title: SJMV: record migrations 0102-0124 as applied (release:db check/mark)
description: They were pasted by hand, so supabase_migrations.schema_migrations is wrong (it claimed up to 0116 while 0102-0110 were missing). Add sjmv to parishes.json (npm run parish -- add), run npm run release:db -- check sjmv, then mark sjmv 0102-0124 (there is no 0119) so a later db push does not rerun them.

title: Parish release SOP: guardrails and follow-ups (epic)
description: Release process for carrying the free main repo's code and migrations to each parish (sjmv, olgqp). THE SOP is written in deploy/04-releases.md on main, section 'Carrying the code to a parish's own website' (commit e5b09f0): parish branches are created FROM main and updated with 'git merge main'; migrate databases first (npm run release:db / release:functions), then push the parish branch; every commit pushed to a parish repo must be authored by that parish's own GitHub noreply account (Vercel Hobby blocks other authors). Per-worktree identities: main=Ruben Dave 57737577+DaveenDev@users.noreply.github.com; PARISH-REGISTRY-sjmvp=SJMVParish 349221330+SJMVparish@users.noreply.github.com; PARISH-REGISTRY-olgqp=guadalupe-muaan 350204497+guadalupe-muaan@users.noreply.github.com. Guardrail 3 (identity per worktree) is DONE; the rest are children of this epic. Never run commands against Guadalupe's project rmlkowkbonbrtaqocsvo from a parish folder.

title: Add demo account login selector, instead of general Demo login button
create new user role called Census Coordinator
Guardrail 5: branch content check (no tracked .env.local, supabase/.temp, other parish IDs)
description: Check run before pushing a parish branch: fail if client/.env.local or supabase/.temp is tracked, or another parish's/demo's project ID or site address appears in the config files.

title: Guardrail 4: script that prints which Supabase project a live site uses
description: npm script: fetch a site's index.html, find its JS bundle, extract https://<ref>.supabase.co and compare with the parish's projectRef from parishes.json. Last step of every release (I did it by hand with curl).

title: Guardrail 2: .gitattributes merge=ours for parish-owned files
description: So git merge main in a parish worktree keeps the parish's own client/.env.production, vercel.json, wrangler.jsonc, public/robots.txt, README, deploy/, docs/ (needs git config merge.ours.driver true). Review main's changes to those files by hand when needed.

title: Guardrail 1: pre-push check of project ID vs target remote
description: Pre-push hook/script that refuses a push when LIVE_PROJECT_ID in client/src/lib/database.js or client/.env.production is not the project of the parish owning the remote being pushed to (map remote -> project in parishes.json). Would have blocked Guadalupe's main being pushed to the SJMV repo.

title: SJMV: set real workers.dev address, then drop Vercel files
description: Once the address is known: Sitemap line in client/public/robots.txt, DEFAULT_SITE_URL in client/src/lib/census.js, site_url in supabase/config.toml. After SJMV is live on Cloudflare delete client/vercel.json and client/api/ from the SJMV branch. Also decide when to remove the noindex rule for sjmvparish hosts in vercel.json (site is kept out of search now).

title: SJMV: move the website to Cloudflare Workers (deploy/05-cloudflare.md)
description: Blocked on the parish Gmail one-time code (secretary). Follow deploy/05-cloudflare.md: import SJMVparish/website, root client, build npm run build, deploy npx wrangler deploy, Worker name sjmvparish. Then repoint Supabase Auth Site URL/Redirect URLs, R2 CORS AllowedOrigins, Parish Config photo Public URL = <site>/media, and run the one-time photo SQL for hero_image/logo/org_nodes/org_gkk_holders. Do after training.

title: Cleanup: main and branch tidy-up
description: Drop the empty parish-authored 9bab7bf from local main before pushing main; check whether Worker name 'site' (342c23d) on main is intended; retire sjmv-fresh, sjmv-deploy and sync-sjmv.ps1; rename sjmvp to parish/sjmv; make main generic (demo) once olgqp holds Guadalupe's settings. Also update remaining mentions of parish-registry-demo.vercel.app (deploy/, docs/, code) to parish-demo.daveen.dev.
